System nearly collapsed during Black Friday peaks multiple times

Database coupling requiring full regression testing for any change

architectureDetail.zh: 基于 AWS EKS 的事件驱动微服务架构。Kafka 实现异步解耦（日均处理 20 亿事件），DynamoDB 处理峰值事务（黑色星期五 50 万 TPS），Istio 服务网格管理金丝雀发布与流量路由。GitOps 通过 ArgoCD 实现，所有基础设施以 Terraform 代码化管理。
architectureDetail.en: Event-driven microservices on AWS EKS. Kafka handles async decoupling (2B events/day). DynamoDB for peak transactions (500K TPS on Black Friday). Istio service mesh for canary releases and traffic routing. GitOps via ArgoCD. All infrastructure managed as code with Terraform.

医生诊断前平均需查阅 3 个系统，耗时 15 分钟
跨院区转诊时患者信息丢失率高达 30%

zh.phase: 第 1 阶段：互操作层建设（12 周）
zh.desc: 基于 FHIR R4 构建统一临床数据平台，连接全部 18 个 EHR 系统

en.desc: Built unified clinical data platform on FHIR R4, connecting all 18 EHR systems

en.phase: Phase 2: AI Clinical Decision Support (16 wks)
en.desc: Developed AI-assisted diagnosis and drug interaction alert system, validated in HIPAA sandbox
Implemented zero-trust data access ensuring end-to-end PHI protection

architectureDetail.zh: FHIR 互操作层基于 HAPI FHIR 构建，通过 MLLP/HL7v2 适配器连接遗留 EHR。临床数据湖采用 AWS Lake Formation 确保列级访问控制。AI 模型在 HIPAA 合规 VPC 中运行，使用 Amazon SageMaker + 专用 HSM 密钥管理。零信任数据访问通过 OPA 策略引擎实施。
architectureDetail.en: FHIR interoperability layer on HAPI FHIR with MLLP/HL7v2 adapters for legacy EHR. Clinical data lake on AWS Lake Formation for column-level access control. AI models run in HIPAA-compliant VPC using SageMaker + dedicated HSM key management. Zero-trust data access enforced via OPA policy engine.

zh.phase: 第 1 阶段：碳排放基线（8 周）

architectureDetail.en: Edge computing gateways on ARM industrial computers collecting SCADA via OPC-UA, streaming through encrypted MQTT to cloud digital twin engine. Cloud: Azure Digital Twins + ADX time-series DB. AI optimization (RL models) runs in air-gapped environment. Carbon dashboard connects to national ESG reporting API.

zh: 碳排放预测准确率达到 95%
非计划停机减少 35%
能耗降低 18%（年减排 120,000 吨 CO2）
OT 安全合规达到 IEC 62443 标准
年度运营成本节省 1.5 亿美元

overview.zh: 传统核保流程依赖人工审核数百页文件，平均耗时 3 周。Evoing 构建了 AI 核保引擎，将核保时间压缩至 2 小时，同时提升风险定价准确率。
overview.en: Traditional underwriting relied on manual review of hundreds of pages, averaging 3 weeks. Evoing built an AI underwriting engine, compressing time to 2 hours while improving risk pricing accuracy.

zh: 人工核保平均 3 周，无法满足数字渠道的实时报价需求
核保决策一致性低：同一案例不同核保人评估差异达 30%
历史理赔数据为非结构化 PDF，难以用于模型训练
监管对 AI 核保的可解释性有严格要求
多语言文件（英语、法语、德语、日语）增加处理复杂度
en: Manual underwriting averaged 3 weeks, cannot meet real-time quoting needs
Low decision consistency: 30% variance between underwriters on same case
Historical claims data in unstructured PDFs, unusable for model training
Regulatory requirements for AI underwriting explainability
Multi-language documents (EN, FR, DE, JP) adding complexity

zh.phase: 第 1 阶段：数据工程（10 周）
zh.desc: NLP 管道提取 10 年历史理赔数据，构建结构化训练集

zh.desc: 训练多模态核保模型（文本+结构化数据），建立可解释性层

zh.phase: 第 3 阶段：核保工作台（8 周）
zh.desc: 构建 AI 辅助核保工作台，核保人确认/修改/驳回 AI 建议

en.desc: NLP pipeline extracted 10 years of claims data into structured training sets
Trained multimodal underwriting model (text + structured), built explainability layer
Built AI-assisted underwriting workbench with human-in-the-loop confirmation/override

architectureDetail.zh: NLP 管道基于 spaCy + 自定义 Transformer 模型，支持 4 种语言的文档理解。核保模型采用 XGBoost + 神经网络集成架构，SHAP 值提供逐条可解释性。核保工作台将 AI 置信度分级：绿色（>95%）自动通过、黄色（80-95%）人工复核、红色（<80%）升级至高级核保人。
architectureDetail.en: NLP pipeline on spaCy + custom Transformer models supporting 4-language document understanding. Underwriting model: XGBoost + neural ensemble with SHAP values for per-decision explainability. Workbench tiers AI confidence: green (>95%) auto-approve, yellow (80-95%) human review, red (<80%) escalate to senior underwriter.

zh: 核保时间从 3 周缩短至 2 小时
核保决策一致性从 70% 提升至 97%
风险定价准确率提升 15%（以损失率衡量）

architectureDetail.zh: 流处理架构基于 Kafka + Flink，日均处理 100 万+ 物流事件。路线优化使用 OR-Tools + 定制约束求解器。异常检测采用时间序列异常检测 + 天气/交通外部信号集成。控制塔基于 React + Deck.gl 提供全球地图可视化。调度决策分为三级：全自动（85%）、建议+确认（12%）、人工决策（3%）。
architectureDetail.en: Streaming architecture on Kafka + Flink processing 1M+ logistics events/day. Route optimization: OR-Tools + custom constraint solver. Anomaly detection: time-series + external weather/traffic signals. Control tower: React + Deck.gl for global map visualization. Dispatch decisions tiered: fully auto (85%), recommend+confirm (12%), manual (3%).
